text: Two bicycles and a tricycle are parked outside. How many wheels in all?
Which is longer: 2 metres, or 150 centimetres?
If today is Wednesday, what day was it ten days ago?
why: Seven days ago was Wednesday; three more back is Sunday.

text: Three whole pizzas are each cut into quarters. How many slices?
Double 35, halve 50, then add the two answers together.
Which is the odd one out: CAT, DOG, COW, OWL?
why: The owl is a bird; the others are mammals.

text: A pencil costs 30p more than a rubber, and together they cost 50p. What does the rubber cost?
why: Rubber 10p, pencil 40p: 40 is 30 more than 10, and they add to 50.

text: Which number do you get both by adding 1, 2 and 3 together and by multiplying them?
A film starts at 7:40pm and runs for 1 hour 50 minutes. When does it finish?
why: 7:40 plus 2 hours is 9:40; take off 10 minutes: 9:30.

text: Count the corners on three squares and two triangles together.
Which whole number is exactly double the whole number just before it?
why: 2 is double 1; for any bigger number, double the one before is too big.

text: Add up every whole number from 1 to 20.
why: Pair them up: 1 + 20, 2 + 19 and so on gives ten pairs of 21.
